verdict.rationale: Scheduling recurring jobs or workflows is a fair question for a billing SaaS, so the axis applies. The pack has no evidence of a user-configurable scheduler or recurring workflow feature. Dunning retry intervals and recurring subscription billing are built-in billing behaviors, not schedulable jobs. Export jobs are one-off asynchronous actions, not a recurring schedule.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
